integrity: All present analytical formulas are derived explicitly; standalone numerical overlap checks corroborate but do not prove the continuum theorem.
scientific_limitations: The sharp phase diagram compares only the three inequivalent symmetry-axis orbits, not all possible translation directions. Independent historical priority remains unconfirmed, especially for crystallographic autocorrelation tables.
title: Three symmetry-axis covariograms and two exact overlap transitions for the rhombic dodecahedron
